sloka: स विह्वलितसर्वाङ्गो गिरिशृङ्गेण ताडितः ।पपात सहसा भूमौ विकीर्ण इव पर्वतः ।। ६.५२.३७ ।।।।
transliteration: sa vihvalitasarvāṅgo giriśṛṅgeṇa tāḍitaḥ ।papāta sahasā bhūmau vikīrṇa iva parvataḥ ।। 6.52.37 ।।।।

translations.english: Those Rakshasas who survived the onslaught, seeing Dhumraksha killed, reentered Lanka out of fear of being killed by Vanaras.
